text.p: Results of the opening
round of matches in the International Cricket Council (ICC)
Trophy on Monday:
Netherlands beat East and Central Africa by eight wickets
Scores: East and Central Africa 26 all out in 15 overs;
Netherlands 27-2 in 5.2 overs
United Arab Emirates beat West Africa by seven wickets
Scores: West Africa 72 all out in 40.2 overs; UAE
73-3 in 14.1 overs
Bermuda beat Italy by seven wickets
Scores: Italy 128-8 in 50 overs; Bermuda 129-3 in 31.1 overs
Kenya beat Israel by seven wickets
Scores: Israel 154-8 in 50 overs; Kenya 157-3 in 31.2 overs
United States beat Singapore by 106 runs
Scores: United States 229-8 in 50 overs; Singapore 123-9 in
50 overs
Denmark beat Malaysia by 31 runs
Scores: Denmark 143 all out in 47.2 overs; Malaysia 112 all
out in 41 overs
Ireland beat Gibralter by 192 runs
Scores: Ireland 278-2 in 50 overs; Gibralter 86 all out in
32.2 overs
Bangladesh beat Argentina by five wickets
Scores: Argentina 138 all out in 48.3 overs; Bangladesh
142-5 in 24 overs
